text:
No, they don't necessarily contradict each other. They measure different things.

Hansen reports the year a pixel lost tree cover (canopy ≥30% in 2000). It recorded 67.7 ha of loss in 2020, which is a historical event before the 2020-12-31 baseline. JRC GFC2020 is a forest/non-forest map of the 2020 state. It shows 0 ha of forest on this asset. Both can be true if the trees were cleared during or before 2020, so that no forest remained at the end of the year. That fits the loss history here (2008, 2015, 2017, 2020).

One oddity is that Hansen's 2000 tree cover is only 23.0 ha, yet its losses total more than that. The tool output doesn't explain this, so I can't resolve it. Differences in definitions and in 30 m versus 10 m resolution may contribute.

For the post-baseline claim, no loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected in 2021–2025. Only 0.4 ha of sub-threshold loss appeared in 2021. This is not a compliance finding.
